Security Architecture

  • ✓ Zero-trust network segmentation between bridge zones
  • ✓ mTLS for all inter-service communication
  • ✓ Hardware security module (HSM) key management
  • ✓ Automatic PII/token redaction at bridge layer
  • ✓ Immutable audit logs with tamper detection

Scaling & Resilience

  • ✓ Horizontal auto-scaling for bridge and agent nodes
  • ✓ Multi-region active-active failover
  • ✓ Circuit breaker patterns for legacy system protection
  • ✓ Graceful degradation with cached context fallback
  • ✓ Blue-green deployment for zero-downtime updates
